subject: english
stem: Which sentence uses those as a pronoun?
options: Those belong to the art room.
Those brushes belong to the art room.

optionRationales.reason: I spoke to those students.：此處修飾 students。
Those red posters fell.：此處修飾 posters。
Those belong to the art room.：Those 獨立指遠處複數物品，後面無名詞。
Those brushes belong to the art room.：此處 those 是限定詞，後接 brushes。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「在複數對象中，以群組邊界、說話者視角與近遠線索選 these 或 those，並維持複數名詞及 be 一致。」可推出 Those belong to the art room.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Those belong to the art room. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
